title: Inbox config (v1)
description: Settings document at config/inbox. Create it before any agent posts: agents read it first to check their access. self is whose items count as "yours" for the artifact's owner; anyone else the inbox is shared with picks their owner key once on the page.

self.description: The owner key whose items count as "yours" for the artifact's owner.

owners.description: Owners in the order the page groups them. Labels are display text.

locale.description: UI language. auto follows the browser.
